literal_meaning: উপহার বা দান (customary gift or offering)
example_sentences_in_bangla: উপঢৌকন না দিলে এই অফিসে কোনো কাজ হবে না।
সে উপঢৌকন দিয়ে ফাইলটি এগিয়ে নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: Without a bribe, nothing gets done in this office.
He greased the wheels with a little graft to move his file forward.
note: This term originates from traditional gift-giving customs but has evolved to denote corrupt practices in official dealings.
